## Summary

Describe the problem, proposed change and compatibility impact.

## Validation

- [ ] Offline tests run; exact command/result stated below.
- [ ] Regression coverage added or explained.
- [ ] Runtime allowlist updated if distribution files changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or run archives included.
- [ ] No weakened sandbox/review boundary or hidden live model calls.

State separately any live tests performed, including OS and Codex version.
Do not describe simulated tests as real native-sandbox validation.
